title: feat(i18n): a design-mode menu rename outside the source language is stored as that language's translation
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB9qsP28anD5tWRUHq8j1xSU)_
Fixes #36504
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up #36873 (`skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md:387` names `GET /api/v1/i18n/locales` but not its answer, so it does not name the `sourceLocale` member this PR adds)

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzhpykmQZe1yMupC2CU

## 维护者速读

- 管理员在设计布局模式下改菜单名称时，用非源语言（例如中文界面、英文源语言）改的名字只对该语言生效，其他语言仍显示原名称；以前在非默认语言下改名会被禁止，或在默认语言下改名会覆盖所有语言。
- 属于设计布局（应用内直接调整菜单）专题，补上“菜单改名按语言落地”这一半，并让服务端告诉控制台哪种语言是源语言。
- 出错时最坏情况是某个语言下的新名称没有生效（显示原名称），原有名称不会被改坏；改动可通过在 Studio 删除对应的翻译条目直接撤回。
- 无

## The contract widening (for the contract-tier review)

**`GetLocalesResponseSchema` gains one optional member, `sourceLocale: string`** (`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`). It is the declared `i18n.sourceLocale`, else the default locale: the collapse every metadata-document translator already makes (`getSourceLocale?.() ?? getDefaultLocale?.()`, the caller's to make per the `II18nService.getSourceLocale` contract). It is absent only when the server knows neither. The name follows its config key (`i18n.sourceLocale`, `translation.zod.ts`), the precedent being the body's own `isDefault` mark named for `i18n.defaultLocale`. The shard moved, measured: `packages/spec/authorable-surface/api.json` gains `api/GetLocalesResponse:sourceLocale` (regenerated, not hand-edited), so `Metadata-protocol: added` and `@objectstack/spec` minor. The one producer is the dispatcher's `/i18n` domain (`packages/runtime/src/domains/i18n.ts`); service-i18n serves no body of its own for this route (its ledger row points at the SDK).

## What changes

- **`GET /api/v1/i18n/locales`** names the source locale (above).
- **Design mode, 「Rename and icon」**: the name field is open in every language. Where the name lands is the save's rule (`labelGoesToTranslation`, `designModeMenuModel.ts`):
  - typed in the source language over an entry shown by its stored label: the stored label, as before;
  - typed in any other language, or in the source language over a translation the reader was shown: that language's translation, and the stored label is kept.
  The dialog says so when the name will be a translation.
- **The translation write** (`designModeMenuSave.ts`): the `translation` item `APP_menu_LOCALE` (`crm_menu_zh_cn`), key `apps.APP.navigation.ID.label` (the key `translateApp` reads), in the package the menu is written to: the app's own when writable, else its `.custom` pair (ADR-0146 D2). The item as stored is read through `/layers`, its other keys kept, and written by the menu's confirmed-save rule (first-write pin, publish pinned to the row read, a refused publish discards the draft). It is written before the menu; a translation-only save writes no app.
- **N5 (comment 7083013814)**: a link added outside the source language is stored without a label, its typed name written as that language's translation, keyed by the id the entry is stored under (`rebaseMenuEdits` now reports a fresh id through `writtenAs`). Measured: `AppSchema` accepts a label-less `url` entry, so no placeholder is invented; a source-language reader sees the URL until someone names it there.
- **Unknown languages** (the locales read failed): every typed name is a translation, which never changes what another language reads.
- Strings: `designMode.menu.renameSourceOnly` is replaced by `renameTranslation`, and `translationPendingDraft` is added, in all eleven packs (zh-Hant regenerated).
- Docs: the two route tables that list `/i18n/locales` say it names the source locale; `content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx` regenerated.

### Done-when, item by item

1. `GET /i18n/locales` exposes the source locale, pinned: `packages/runtime/src/i18n-supported-locales.test.ts` (real `AppPlugin` + memory i18n + dispatcher; `defaultLocale: 'zh-CN', sourceLocale: 'en'` answers `sourceLocale: 'en'`; no declaration answers the default) and `protocol.test.ts` (the parse keeps the member).
2. A zh-CN rename over an English source writes the zh-CN translation and leaves the stored label; read back through `translateApp`, zh-CN shows the new name and an English reader the base label (`designModeMenuSave-36363.test.ts`, and end to end in `DesignModeMenu-36363.test.tsx`).
3. The guard is relaxed: both former guard pins are rewritten to the new behaviour.
4. Object and field labels: not served by this path. The console edits no object or field label in design mode today, and a translation of those lives under `objects.OBJECT...` and is read by `translateObject` with its own packaged-base and field-patch ranks (ADR-0146 D10), so it needs its own split rule rather than this menu's. The locale read (`fetchDeploymentLocales`, `labelLanguageOf`) is shared and reusable.

### Server-side reach, measured before building the console half

A translation row in the `.custom` pair is served at rank 1 on the override (`getPairTranslationBundle` → `pairBundle`, `labelCatalogs`), for nodes the override changed and nodes it left alone; the real-boot pin is `packages/objectql/src/protocol-custom-override-bare-slot-envelope.test.ts` (the #30504 describe: a node on the pair's override reads the pair's translation). An own-package app's row reaches the deployment catalog through the authored-translation sync.

## Tests

<details><summary>Local readings (head after the last fix commit)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/api/protocol.test.ts src/system/i18n-resolver.test.ts`: Test Files 2 passed, Tests 811 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/i18n-supported-locales.test.ts src/i18n-success-envelope.conformance.test.ts src/domains/i18n-anonymous-deny.test.ts`: the anonymous-deny literal needed the new member (fixed in this PR); see the report comment for the final reading.
- `ui`: `vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/ packages/i18n/src/__tests__/` plus the two RecordTabsConfig suites (which share the locales read): 271 files, one stale zh-Hant catalogue (regenerated in this PR); final reading in the report comment.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: 14 of 14 current after `--fix` (check:docs regenerated `protocol.mdx`; authorable-surface regenerated over the merged tree).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck`: `tsc --noEmit` clean; `check:test-typecheck` names three files this diff does not touch (`boolean-written-spelling-row-scope.test.ts`, `meta-object-publish-column-changes.test.ts`, `organization-ownership-boot-guard.turso-remote.kernel.test.ts`), left to CI's reading.
- `type-check` of `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n`: NOT MEASURED locally (the ui project references need every ui package's `dist`); CI's Type Check UI carries it.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (one per tested behaviour, restored by `git checkout HEAD`, restore proven by an empty `git diff HEAD`)</summary>

- The producer stops emitting `sourceLocale` (`ablation-replace.mjs` on `domains/i18n.ts`): `i18n-supported-locales.test.ts` red (exit 1); restored clean.
- `labelGoesToTranslation` answers "stored" outside the source language: `designModeMenuSave-36363.test.ts` and `DesignModeMenu-36363.test.tsx` red (exit 1); restored clean.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Overlap**: #36848 (report editing, this area, draft) conflicts textually in `DesignModeMenu.tsx` (its removal of the report-slot block meets this PR's `labels` argument on the report save) and `designModeMenuCreate.ts` (imports). Mechanical; the second to land resolves.
- File surface: `designModeMenuCreate.ts` is touched for one type line (`AppMenuSaveInput & { item }`) so a dashboard or report created from the picker carries the label language too; without it a zh rename staged before 「New dashboard…」 would be written to the stored label.
- A translation item of another name for the same locale in the pair that keys the same navigation id merges by item name order (`readAuthoredTranslationLayer`); the design mode writes and reads only its own `APP_menu_LOCALE` item.
- In the source language, a rename over a stored inline locale map (`label: { en, zh-CN }`) still replaces the whole map with a string, as before this PR; noted, not changed here.
- `RecordTabsConfig`'s tab-rename gate still compares the session with the default locale (`fetchDefaultLocale`, unchanged behaviour); with `sourceLocale` now served it can compare with the source locale. Reported to the seat, not changed here.

## Verification

First read (by risk): `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/designModeMenuSave.ts` (`prepareAppMenuSave` label split and `writeMenuTranslation`), `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/designModeMenuModel.ts` (`labelGoesToTranslation`, `splitLabelEdits`, `writtenAs`), `packages/runtime/src/domains/i18n.ts` (the locales body).

Two minutes: `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/designModeMenuSave-36363.test.ts` — expect the `objectstack#36504` describes green, including "a rename under zh-CN over an English source: the zh-CN translation is written and published, the stored label is not".
